paper_title: Schuldenbremse und öffentliche Investitionen: Erwiderung auf Mühlenweg et al. (2024)
caption: Fiskalregel-Index des IWF
model_annotation:
The diagrams display the IWF Fiskalindex alongside the Schuldenquote Gesamtstaat and Schuldenquote Zentralstaat over time. The x-axis represents the years from 1995 to 2020 with a linear scale, tick marks at every 5 years, and labels at every 5 years. The left y-axis represents the IWF Fiskalindex with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 2.5, with tick marks at every 0.5 units. The right y-axis for the first diagram represents the Schuldenquote Gesamtstaat, ranging from 60 to 120, with tick marks at every 20 units, while the right y-axis for the second diagram represents the Schuldenquote Zentralstaat, ranging from 30 to 70, with tick marks at every 10 units.

The first diagram includes four lines: a blue line representing the IWF Fiskalindex, which starts at around 0 in 1995, increases to approximately 1 in 2009, and then decreases to around 0.25 in 2020, with a slight increase to 0.4 by 2021; a purple line representing the Schuldenquote Gesamtstaat, which begins at around 60 in 1995, peaks at approximately 83 in 2010, remains relatively stable until 2020, and then increases sharply to around 110 by 2021; blue triangular markers representing a value of 1 on the IWF Fiskalindex scale; and red triangular markers indicating values between 0.75 and 1 on the IWF Fiskalindex scale. The second diagram also includes four lines: a blue line representing the IWF Fiskalindex, which starts at around -3 in 1995, rises to approximately 0.5 in 2009, dips slightly, and then decreases to around -0.2 in 2020 before increasing to 0.75 by 2021; a purple line representing the Schuldenquote Zentralstaat, which begins at around 36 in 1995, peaks at approximately 50 in 2010, remains relatively stable until 2020, and then increases sharply to around 65 by 2021; blue triangular markers indicating a value of 1 on the IWF Fiskalindex scale; and red triangular markers representing values between 0.5 and 0.75 on the IWF Fiskalindex scale.
